scope: Final Stage-2 VA000050 profile relocation and PRL000291 were preserved; the linked official GFK archive was retrieved and unpacked only for static inspection, yielding one active MATLAB demo experiment and one active configuration.

unresolved_findings.finding: GFK.zip contains no license file or license statement for the MATLAB source or bundled feature data.

The source identifies MATLAB and calls functions including princomp, gsvd and zscore, but no MATLAB version, toolbox/runtime dependency specification, environment manifest or installation procedure is provided.
The active 20-trial demo uses random per-class sampling without an explicit seed.
The active demo prints per-trial and mean accuracy but the archive supplies no reference expected value for the active webcam-to-DSLR configuration.

notes: The bundled MAT payloads were not loaded, and no scientific software, dataset, test or benchmark was executed.
